headline_findings: "After moving, you may attack" is read as a precondition. Whole table played it wrong for two rounds.
Bulk selling has no price penalty, so the leader converts an early lead into a locked win by round 3.
Storm expiry is untracked hidden state and gets forgotten.

common_misreads: 4.2: attack treated as conditional on moving
social_dynamics: Table copied the first player's misread rather than checking the book
emotional_arc: Engaged through round 2; new player disengaged in round 4 once the lead looked unbeatable
attention_breakpoints: Weather upkeep at end of round; nobody owns it

recommended_changes.change: 4.2: "On your turn you may move, then you may attack. You can attack without moving."
5.3: each cargo sold beyond the second in one action drops the price by 1.
recommended_changes.reason: Diminishing returns on bulk selling; gives trailing players a window.
recommended_changes.blast_radius_guess: Market track, end-game scoring totals, any card that sets price.

recommended_changes.change: 6.1: storm token goes on the round track at the round it expires.
recommended_changes.reason: Moves hidden state onto the board.
